body.prose:
The field has no single hierarchy. In the store every holon stands flat, an id and its version; order and nesting live only in bodies, in a brief's parts, a lone link. So the root is no holon of the field's own making but a mount: what the reader is looking at, held as data. Glass ships one as its entry, giving the field's roots, what nothing references, grouped by type, and a holarchy such as this wiki is entered from there, like anything else.

The primitives themselves are still: they hold no state, take no press and move nowhere. Looking around is something built on them, and what it needs is a place to look and a way to move: the root mount, offered where the page's address says, as [§8](ref:01M6JZY20ZJAAP3CBJ4KRDBXFD) tells.

*The author's, [2026-11-03](ref:01M6GXP142MQFYEW77T03MHTFP): there is no state, no interaction and no navigation in the primitives, and that is something to birth upon them; the root should be an actual reading, not a custom component. That the entry once stood at the field itself as a projection, drawn by a component of its own, is let go in it.*
body.title: The root is a mount
